units.previous_finding: Source emphasis covers the complete term _zero_value_, but the current candidate uses valor _zero_, so only zero is emphasized. The visible wording is semantically correct, but the emphasis scope no longer corresponds to the complete source term zero value / valor zero. Revision should preserve the intended complete-term emphasis.

The explanation of implicit break behavior contains translationese: «la sentència break ... s'aplica automàticament a Go» is not natural Catalan technical prose and makes the semantics less precise; «els casos switch de Go» is likewise awkward. Revise to natural Catalan without changing Go behavior.

«Els casos d'un switch s'avaluen de dalt a baix i s'aturen quan un cas té èxit» closely calques English. Grammatically, s'aturen makes the cases themselves stop, while the intended meaning is that evaluation stops after the first matching case; «un cas té èxit» is also unnatural Catalan.

Title «Els Slices són com referències a matrius» retains an English source-title capital in the middle of a Catalan title. Keep the technical identity slice untranslated, but use natural Catalan capitalization and syntax.

Title «Literals de Slice» retains source-title capitalization on slice after moving it to a non-initial position. Preserve the technical identity slice while using natural Catalan sentence-case styling.

Title «Valors predeterminats dels Slice» is grammatically inconsistent: dels is plural while Slice is presented as singular. Preserve the technical identity slice while restoring grammatical number and natural Catalan title syntax.
Title «Longitud i capacitat d'un Slice» retains source-title capitalization after a Catalan article in a non-initial position. The technical term is correct but needs natural Catalan casing/syntax.

Title «slices nil» begins lowercase and is not a natural Catalan title; body «Un nil slice té una longitud...» preserves English modifier order. Keep nil and slice technical identities unchanged but use natural Catalan word order and title form.

Body begins «Els Slices es poden crear...». After the Catalan article Els, the source sentence-initial capital on Slices becomes an unnatural mid-sentence capital. Preserve the technical identity and revise casing/structure naturally.

Body «Els Slices poden contenir qualsevol tipus...» has the same unnatural mid-sentence source capitalization after the Catalan article. Preserve the technical identity and revise casing/structure naturally.

Source: «A nil error denotes success; a non-nil error denotes failure.» Current candidate states «Un nil error indica èxit; un nil error indica fallada.» The second clause loses the essential non- distinction and therefore says that a nil error denotes both success and failure. This reverses/invalidates a core Go error semantic and is directly contradictory. Revision must restore the distinction between nil and non-nil error values while preserving the technical identities nil and error.

Current candidate contains «tots els elements slice». slice is correctly retained as a technical identity, but the surrounding phrase preserves English noun-modifier order from «slice elements» rather than forming a natural Catalan construction. Revision should retain slice while integrating it into natural Catalan syntax.

Current candidate contains «Les Goroutines s'executen...». The technical term goroutines must remain untranslated, but after adding the Catalan article Les, retaining the English source-initial capitalization creates an unnatural mid-sentence capital. A minor Catalan casing/syntactic adjustment is required.

Opening sentence «Els canals són un conducte tipat...» combines the plural subject Els canals with the singular predicate nominal un conducte tipat, producing a clear number-agreement / sentence-construction defect in the principal definition. Revision should preserve the meaning that channels are a typed conduit through which values can be sent and received while restoring natural Catalan number agreement and syntax.
